# RockULA repository instructions
Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) first. It is the canonical guide for architecture, workflow,
validation and truthful completion reporting.
Read the relevant architecture document, current plan and path-specific instructions before edits.
Implement the C# hardware core from scratch. Keep UI/filesystem/wall-clock behavior in hosts.
Do not include firmware/games or turn roadmap entries into implemented claims.
Use the restore/build/test/format commands in AGENTS and report unavailable checks explicitly.
